skill.name: trpc-scaffolder
skill.description: Scaffold tRPC routers, procedure snippets, and Zod schemas for type-safe TypeScript APIs.
skill.summary: Creates tRPC scaffolding patterns and validation checks for TypeScript API work.
skill.author: ArieGoldkin

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are benign markdown code fences, TypeScript template literals, relative imports, or fixed project-root paths. The audit found real script hardening issues: unvalidated names can escape output directories, and unescaped sed replacements can corrupt generated code. No prompt-injection or data-exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Script arguments are used in output paths without validation.
remediation.suggestion: Reject names containing dot segments, slashes, backslashes, whitespace, or shell metacharacters before building file paths.

remediation.issue: Generated output paths are not constrained after resolution.
remediation.suggestion: Resolve each output path and verify it remains under the intended routers or schemas directory before writing.

remediation.issue: sed replacements use unescaped user-controlled values.
remediation.suggestion: Escape replacement values or replace the Bash templating with a small typed script that writes structured files safely.

semantic_findings.title: Unvalidated Script Names Can Escape Output Directories
semantic_findings.description: The router and schema scripts place user-supplied names into output file paths without rejecting path separators or dot segments. A crafted name can write outside the intended routers or schemas directory.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The scripts assign raw arguments to name variables and then build OUTPUT_FILE paths from those values. No validation blocks ../, slashes, or absolute path syntax before writing.

semantic_findings.title: Unescaped Template Replacement Values
semantic_findings.description: The scripts substitute user-controlled names directly into sed replacement expressions. Special characters can break generation or inject unintended text into scaffolded code.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The sed replacement strings interpolate shell variables directly. Quoting prevents shell execution, but replacement metacharacters and delimiters are not escaped before code generation.

content.value_statement: Building tRPC routers and schemas manually can slow API work. This skill provides reusable scaffolds, examples, and checks for type-safe endpoints.
actual_capabilities: Creates tRPC router files from a local template.
Creates Zod schema files with inferred TypeScript types.
Outputs query or mutation procedure snippets for existing routers.
Checks router registration and schema type exports.
Provides examples for errors, context, tests, and pagination.
limitations: Assumes the DevPrep AI frontend folder layout.
Does not implement endpoint business logic.
Script arguments need careful validation before use.

use_cases.title: Create a Feature Router
use_cases.description: Generate a starter tRPC router and follow the registration steps for a new API domain.

use_cases.title: Add a Typed Procedure
use_cases.description: Produce a query or mutation snippet that matches the project router pattern.

use_cases.title: Standardize Validation Schemas
use_cases.description: Create Zod schema files with exported inferred types for endpoint inputs and outputs.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Router
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new API domain.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a tRPC router for user features using the project pattern. Include the file path and registration steps.

prompt_templates.title: Add a Procedure
prompt_templates.scenario: Add one endpoint to an existing router.
prompt_templates.prompt: Add a query procedure named getHints to the ai router. Include required input and output schemas.

prompt_templates.title: Design Schemas
prompt_templates.prompt: Create Zod schemas for a profile update endpoint. Include input, output, constants, and inferred types.

prompt_templates.title: Audit an Endpoint Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this tRPC endpoint plan for schema coverage, authorization, error handling, registration, and test gaps.

output_examples.output: The skill creates a router file, lists registration changes, and points to schema steps.

output_examples.input: Add getHints as a query procedure.
output_examples.output: The skill provides a procedure outline with input validation, output validation, and next implementation steps.
The skill checks router registration, reports missing schema type exports, and suggests follow-up type checks.

best_practices: Validate every procedure with explicit input and output schemas.
Register each new router in the central app router before use.
Keep business logic in services and call it from procedures.
anti_patterns: Do not use mutations for read-only data fetching.
Do not skip inferred type exports from schema files.
Do not run scaffolding scripts with names that contain path separators.

faq.question: Does this skill write production endpoint logic?
faq.answer: No. It creates scaffolds and examples. Developers still implement business logic and authorization.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it create Zod schemas?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a schema script and examples for inferred TypeScript types.

faq.question: Can it validate an existing setup?
faq.answer: Yes. The validation script checks router registration and schema type exports.

faq.question: Is it tied to one project layout?
faq.answer: Yes. The scripts assume a DevPrep AI frontend path structure.

faq.question: What should users review before running scripts?
faq.answer: Users should confirm script arguments are simple names and contain no path separators.
